integrity: Analytical proof with a standalone finite-grid numerical consistency test; no formal or independent proof certificate.
scientific_limitations: The sharp formula and half-circle rigidity require real periodic BV data and a strictly positive convolution density. The late-time turning point classification is asymptotic at each fixed nonzero drift, and does not determine all early extrema. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Sharp circular BV drift–diffusion error and infinitely recurrent peaks
